headline: Colorado Replaces Flat Tax with 8.4% Graduated Income Tax Rate
summary: Colorado has eliminated its flat income tax structure, replacing it with a new graduated income tax rate set at 8.4%.
why: State tax policy changes alter the fiscal landscape for resident taxpayers, corporate relocations, and municipal bond markets.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Changes to state income tax rates alter disposable income and local economic competitiveness.
